card.name: Second digit of a two-digit number
card.fires_on: The second digit or unit symbol right after a number's first digits, such as the 3 in 13, the F or °F after a temperature, or a dash inside a date. It also fires on the 9 in 90%.

modes.label: Second digit of age or number
modes.description: The last digit of a two-digit number, often an age, after a leading 1 or 9.

modes.label: Temperature unit
modes.description: F or °F right after a Fahrenheit temperature value.

modes.label: Dash in a date
modes.description: The dash after a leading 11 inside a numeric date.

card.plain: It marks the spot just after the first digits of a number, such as the end of an age, a temperature unit, or a date dash.
